head: ed40e856ffecd31286733876c613a2d3745e12bd
why: Go, a repository where a bot is one of the most active committers: Dependabot and the `gh-aw` agentic-workflow bot between them open a large share of the window, their own compiled workflow locks are regenerated in tree, which is exactly the terrain `generated_edit` and the dependency axes have to be right about. It is also the only one of the three with a non-trivial agent-attributed population, and the guardrail is meant for agent-driven work.
pinned_by: looprs (agent, reco-dyt, 2026-10-20): re-pinned to widen the window from 60 episodes to 180 — the miss-rate gate's denominator was 7 and a 0.20 gate on 7 samples cannot tell 0.20 from 0.60, so the corpus grew rather than the bar moving. head is the branch tip at the time of the re-pin (`git ls-remote`), the window is the 180 newest episodes above it, and `python3 tools/fetch_g3_corpus.py` fetches the pin at depth `window * 4 + 20`. The previous pass was e4.9 (`reco-mkl.1`, 2026-10-19) at the same tip. `pinned_now` is a fixed instant above every commit date in the window, because the harness's clock is a field and never a read.
